line_4b3595f3.speaker: otter
line_4b3595f3.text: Mosey! I spelled 'breakfast' in the sand. Now I am hungry.

line_346f97c9.speaker: mosey
line_346f97c9.text: You are always hungry. That is three breakfasts today.

line_6370a177.speaker: otter
line_6370a177.text: Three is a very good number.

line_0db2687c.speaker: otter
line_0db2687c.text: The flowers have gone grey. We have to fix this!

line_441c4686.speaker: mosey
line_441c4686.text: Look, a word bubble by that flower. Try the missing letter!

line_044ac971.speaker: otter
line_044ac971.text: It bloomed! The colour came back!

line_47a1f912.speaker: mosey
line_47a1f912.text: So our answers bring the world back to life.

line_f8eb8524.speaker: otter
line_f8eb8524.text: Six islands. Six fragments. One snack break. Let us go!

line_c6ed7ad3.speaker: otter
line_c6ed7ad3.text: Look, Mosey! Word bubbles are stuck in the trees.

line_73310ce7.speaker: mosey
line_73310ce7.text: Fill in the missing letters and they will pop!

line_6aafc015.speaker: otter
line_6aafc015.text: Popping things is my favourite subject.

line_d9e00389.speaker: mosey
line_d9e00389.text: Look! The flowers are waking up.

line_59da1674.speaker: otter
line_59da1674.text: Our answers bring the colour back!

line_7e17605f.speaker: otter
line_7e17605f.text: Uh oh. The bridge has vanished!

line_25affb33.speaker: mosey
line_25affb33.text: Each right answer builds a rainbow plank.

line_f41e72a5.speaker: otter
line_f41e72a5.text: Then I shall walk on rainbows. Naturally.

line_5cbdebbe.speaker: otter
line_5cbdebbe.text: I crossed a rainbow! My feet feel fizzy.

line_f9730f53.speaker: mosey
line_f9730f53.text: Hop on, Otter. The river is the fastest way.

line_301ac67b.speaker: otter
line_301ac67b.text: Type the words to make us zoom!

line_cf5646df.speaker: mosey
line_cf5646df.text: Hold on to my frills. Gently!

line_72660315.speaker: mosey
line_72660315.text: The fireflies have lost their glow.

line_f8343f4b.speaker: otter
line_f8343f4b.text: Tricky words ahead. I love tricky words!

line_7e6f5893.speaker: tree
line_7e6f5893.text: WHO is making all that cheerful noise in MY woods?

line_b283540b.speaker: otter
line_b283540b.text: Hello, Mr Tree! We are looking for a crystal fragment.

line_75ccacd5.speaker: tree
line_75ccacd5.text: Bah! Spell my word muddles first. If you can!

line_08333424.speaker: mosey
line_08333424.text: One fragment found. Five to go!

line_b7ab72b3.speaker: otter
line_b7ab72b3.text: The whole wood is green again!

line_4e635e09.speaker: tree
line_4e635e09.text: Harrumph! My leaves have gone grey and so has my mood!

line_1b341c14.speaker: tree
line_1b341c14.text: Stop it. I am NOT smiling. That is just how my bark sits.

line_7454ac5a.speaker: tree
line_7454ac5a.text: Oh no. I can feel a giggle coming. Hold it in, Grumblebark!

line_0945f2cf.speaker: tree
line_0945f2cf.text: Ha ha ha! I have not laughed in a hundred years!

line_e198253e.speaker: tree
line_e198253e.text: Take the crystal fragment. And come back for a story, little ones.

line_43e72b5f.speaker: otter
line_43e72b5f.text: A talking tree who tells stories? Best. Day. Ever.

line_26adc4d9.speaker: mosey
line_26adc4d9.text: Welcome to my favourite place. Maths under the sea!

line_e0df1fca.speaker: mosey
line_e0df1fca.text: The one with the right answer. Follow me!

line_760300f7.speaker: otter
line_760300f7.text: You swim so fast when you are right!

line_5a1caf6e.speaker: otter
line_5a1caf6e.text: A canyon. Under the sea. How?

line_6e70fb68.speaker: mosey
line_6e70fb68.text: Do not ask how. Ask how many!

line_0f4cf957.speaker: mosey
line_0f4cf957.text: A rainbow under water. Now I have seen everything.

line_168475a1.speaker: otter
line_168475a1.text: Treasure chests! But they are locked.

line_94055a91.speaker: mosey
line_94055a91.text: Type the answer to pop each lock.

line_068b30f1.speaker: otter
line_068b30f1.text: I hope one is full of fish biscuits.

line_624ea6c4.speaker: otter
line_624ea6c4.text: No fish biscuits. But look at all these new friends!

line_c567cfb8.speaker: mosey
line_c567cfb8.text: The old shipwreck! Stay close, Otter.

line_f0ee2edf.speaker: otter
line_f0ee2edf.text: I am not scared. You are scared.

line_266d517c.speaker: mosey
line_266d517c.text: I am a mosasaur. I am never scared.

line_6dd93b2a.speaker: otter
line_6dd93b2a.text: We made it! Was that a ghost?

line_088cbad2.speaker: mosey
line_088cbad2.text: That was a jellyfish in a hat.

line_deba6d19.speaker: octopus
line_deba6d19.text: Oh dear, oh dear. Is that two visitors or twelve?

line_89f96708.speaker: mosey
line_89f96708.text: Just two, Inky. Are you feeling muddled?

line_9ec00d90.speaker: octopus
line_9ec00d90.text: Terribly! Help me sort my sums out!

line_bf17b1a9.speaker: otter
line_bf17b1a9.text: Two fragments! We make a brilliant team.

line_43ceeb74.speaker: octopus
line_43ceeb74.text: Eight arms… or is it nine? I have lost count of EVERYTHING!

line_26367f35.speaker: octopus
line_26367f35.text: Wait, that helps! But now my sums are all in a knot.

line_31c97e29.speaker: octopus
line_31c97e29.text: Nearly untangled! Do I add this arm or take it away?

line_dab9703c.speaker: octopus
line_dab9703c.text: Eight! I have EIGHT arms! Thank you, clever friends!

line_5746de22.speaker: octopus
line_5746de22.text: Here, I was sitting on this shiny thing.

line_ced185bb.speaker: mosey
line_ced185bb.text: That is the crystal fragment! Good sitting, Inky.

line_b48310e2.speaker: otter
line_b48310e2.text: Dragon eggs! They are getting cold.

line_e7d41269.speaker: mosey
line_e7d41269.text: Type the answer to hatch each one.

line_c461c9aa.speaker: otter
line_c461c9aa.text: They think I am their mum.

line_e0a3e45b.speaker: mosey
line_e0a3e45b.text: You do have the right hair.

line_91812a17.speaker: mosey
line_91812a17.text: A warm river. Lovely for my flippers.

line_19646eb3.speaker: mosey
line_19646eb3.text: Count in jumps if you get stuck.

line_5fa7297a.speaker: mosey
line_5fa7297a.text: That was like a bubbly bath. With maths.

line_76276166.speaker: mosey
line_76276166.text: Then let us not fall in. Bridge time!

line_dd10f21a.speaker: otter
line_dd10f21a.text: My tail did not get toasted. Success!

line_587481e0.speaker: mosey
line_587481e0.text: More eggs, deep in the crystal cave.

line_e9170059.speaker: otter
line_e9170059.text: So many dragons. I need more arms for cuddles.

line_56e94e50.speaker: dragon
line_56e94e50.text: Halt! I am Sir Scorch, the fearsome… ouch. Warm.

line_f9337626.speaker: otter
line_f9337626.text: Excuse me. Your trousers are on fire.

line_6e03c375.speaker: dragon
line_6e03c375.text: Nonsense! Dragons do not… oh. OH! Not again!

line_3cbdf25e.speaker: dragon
line_3cbdf25e.text: Behold my mighty fl… is something burning?

line_d6704ca7.speaker: dragon
line_d6704ca7.text: It is my TROUSERS! Again! Quick, distract me with times tables!

line_085bdeb9.speaker: dragon
line_085bdeb9.text: Still a bit toasty back there. One more round!

line_d4527a59.speaker: mosey
line_d4527a59.text: Hold still, Sir Scorch. One splash coming up!

line_8af84091.speaker: dragon
line_8af84091.text: Ahhh. Thank you. These were my best trousers.

line_8cbb42dc.speaker: dragon
line_8cbb42dc.text: Take the fragment. It was making my pocket itchy.

line_9a441d98.speaker: otter
line_9a441d98.text: We are flying! On a cloud! Mosey, you are flying!

line_c99bbc77.speaker: mosey
line_c99bbc77.text: I am a sky mosasaur now. Type to keep us going!

line_30677b50.speaker: mosey
line_30677b50.text: Flying is just swimming with extra air.

line_89e0306e.speaker: otter
line_89e0306e.text: Word bubbles, all the way up here!

line_039021a7.speaker: otter
line_039021a7.text: Endings are my second favourite. After beginnings.

line_925603d3.speaker: otter
line_925603d3.text: Pop, pop, pop. The sky is turning blue again!

line_6fc9119d.speaker: mosey
line_6fc9119d.text: Some words sound the same but mean different things.

line_0eb3c94d.speaker: mosey
line_0eb3c94d.text: Pick the right one to build each cloud step.

line_49a8dbac.speaker: otter
line_49a8dbac.text: I can SEE the SEA from here. Ha!

line_f16e2d90.speaker: otter
line_f16e2d90.text: We made it through! My whiskers are tingling.

line_66e31df5.speaker: wizard
line_66e31df5.text: Ooh, visitors! Want to see a trick?

line_bfdc8640.speaker: wizard
line_bfdc8640.text: Nope! It is a WORD MUDDLE! Tee hee!

line_044898e9.speaker: mosey
line_044898e9.text: Four fragments. The sky is clear!

line_ff41b997.speaker: otter
line_ff41b997.text: And we made a new friend.

line_d12197e6.speaker: wizard
line_d12197e6.text: Tee hee! I jumbled all the words in the sky!

line_75f1c73c.speaker: wizard
line_75f1c73c.text: Hey! Stop fixing things! Take THAT word muddle!

line_c05f9ef6.speaker: wizard
line_c05f9ef6.text: My best spell! Nobody can… oh. You can.

line_c60bb441.speaker: wizard
line_c60bb441.text: All right, all right. You win. That was fun!

line_354499ed.speaker: wizard
line_354499ed.text: Nobody ever plays with me up here.

line_8a4dc418.speaker: otter
line_8a4dc418.text: Then come and play with us! After you hand over the fragment.

line_1242abc0.speaker: otter
line_1242abc0.text: Everything here is made of SWEETS.

line_346bee55.speaker: mosey
line_346bee55.text: Do not lick the scenery, Otter.

line_76a6c3a1.speaker: otter
line_76a6c3a1.text: Too late. Let us open these jars by sharing equally!

line_91e2e61c.speaker: otter
line_91e2e61c.text: Fair shares for everyone. Mostly me.

line_e30230bc.speaker: mosey
line_e30230bc.text: A chocolate river. I may never leave.

line_187f87a4.speaker: mosey
line_187f87a4.text: Half of a thing is that thing shared by two.

line_1ce188a7.speaker: mosey
line_1ce188a7.text: I am now one quarter chocolate.

line_703e15c6.speaker: otter
line_703e15c6.text: It was not me. This time.

line_237ec439.speaker: otter
line_237ec439.text: A rainbow biscuit bridge. Can I keep it?

line_8021fd8b.speaker: mosey
line_8021fd8b.text: Hold your nose. We are going under the fudge falls.

line_a2859bb2.speaker: otter
line_a2859bb2.text: I have fudge in my ears.

line_d4c2d15b.speaker: marshmallow
line_d4c2d15b.text: PUFF is the biggest! Puff keeps ALL the sweets!

line_521ba7f3.speaker: mosey
line_521ba7f3.text: That does not sound very fair, Puff.

line_c2663dd6.speaker: marshmallow
line_c2663dd6.text: Fair? Puff does not know how to share!

line_c5388f9c.speaker: mosey
line_c5388f9c.text: And it is on Starlight Island.

line_c67ffce0.speaker: marshmallow
line_c67ffce0.text: MINE! All the sweets are MINE! …How many is that?

line_d167234b.speaker: marshmallow
line_d167234b.text: Sharing? What is sharing? Show Puff!

line_6aa57a78.speaker: marshmallow
line_6aa57a78.text: Half for you, half for me… Puff is getting it!

line_a41b8cd7.speaker: marshmallow
line_a41b8cd7.text: Sharing makes the sweets taste BETTER!

line_b3f2297b.speaker: marshmallow
line_b3f2297b.text: Puff shares the shiny thing too.

line_c20ae3f9.speaker: mosey
line_c20ae3f9.text: The fragment! Thank you, Puff. Fair shares all round.

line_28d2c56d.speaker: mosey
line_28d2c56d.text: Every word we spell lights one up.

line_378e2412.speaker: otter
line_378e2412.text: Then let us light the whole sky!

line_3a0b5569.speaker: mosey
line_3a0b5569.text: We can swim through stardust up here!

line_b4c88c0c.speaker: otter
line_b4c88c0c.text: I have stardust in my scarf. Fancy.

line_9e4db1c1.speaker: mosey
line_9e4db1c1.text: Type carefully and we will fly straight.

line_4d1c8f57.speaker: mosey
line_4d1c8f57.text: That was our best flying yet.

line_41251a1a.speaker: otter
line_41251a1a.text: One last bridge, made of stars.

line_7ffa4a3f.speaker: mosey
line_7ffa4a3f.text: Words and numbers together this time.

line_a90a27f7.speaker: otter
line_a90a27f7.text: We built a bridge out of STARS, Mosey.

line_9a7aa39a.speaker: shadow
line_9a7aa39a.text: You came all this way for a crystal?

line_dcd5bdcd.speaker: otter
line_dcd5bdcd.text: And to find out who broke it.

line_3e24359b.speaker: shadow
line_3e24359b.text: I did not mean to. I only wanted to hold something bright.

line_10b91d0f.speaker: mosey
line_10b91d0f.text: We did it together. That is the real magic.

line_3c8e8ac2.speaker: shadow
line_3c8e8ac2.text: Go away. Shadows do not have friends.

line_cadc9899.speaker: shadow
line_cadc9899.text: Why are you being kind to me? It makes me feel… warm.

line_bf8b6ae9.speaker: shadow
line_bf8b6ae9.text: If the crystal comes back… will I disappear?

line_ee5f9b80.speaker: mosey
line_ee5f9b80.text: You will not disappear, Umbra. Shadows need the light.

line_701d85be.speaker: otter
line_701d85be.text: And friends need friends. Come with us!

line_0383e1fc.speaker: shadow
line_0383e1fc.text: I… I would like that. Here. I kept it safe for you.
